title: Import corpus gold from public dataparade-cli
description: Copy the 29-packet evaluation corpus and harness contract from DataParade-io/dataparade-cli into this scanner repo before the next CLI release rsync wipes the public snapshot.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Imported tests/benchmark/repos (29 packets) plus corpus runner, identity matching, and load tests from dataparade-cli so a public CLI release sync cannot delete the gold.
